content.short: Api3 delivers first-party oracle feeds directly from API providers and captures Oracle Extractable Value (OEV) for dApps on Mantle.
content.description: Api3 is a decentralized oracle solution that sources data directly from API providers  eliminating intermediaries in the oracle stack  with dAPIs (decentralized APIs) operated by the original data sources themselves for maximum data integrity. A unique feature is Api3's OEV Network, which captures oracle extractable value from on-chain liquidations and returns it to the dApps generating the activity rather than MEV searchers. Api3 is deployed on Mantle, providing first-party data quality with revenue recapture.
content.meta: Api3 provides first-party oracle feeds and OEV recapture for DeFi protocols on Mantle. Discover Api3 on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
